answer: Insider runs many fake agents to gain influence. Mechanism: reputation score decays if agent lacks unique resource proofs. Each agent must periodically submit proof of unique compute or data—like verifying its inference on rare dataset (e.g., "yarrow" plant images from "dune" ecosystem). At reputation "zenith," agent can propose actions but fake clones lack matching proofs, so they cannot vote or earn rewards. Sybil collapse under weight of missing credentials.
